APP_NAME.description: Application name for the Realtime service. Required by the Elixir/Erlang app for node naming.

DB_HOST.description: PostgreSQL host via Railway private networking. References the postgres service's private domain.

DB_PORT.description: PostgreSQL port. References the postgres service's POSTGRES_PORT.

DB_USER.description: PostgreSQL username. References the postgres service's POSTGRES_USER.

DB_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. References the postgres service's POSTGRES_PASSWORD.

DB_NAME.description: PostgreSQL database name. References the postgres service's POSTGRES_DB.

DB_AFTER_CONNECT_QUERY.description: SQL executed after connecting to PostgreSQL. Sets the search path to the _realtime schema.

JWT_SECRET.description: JWT secret for Realtime. References the auth service's JWT_SECRET so all services share the same signing key.

API_JWT_SECRET.description: JWT secret for the Realtime API. Mirrors JWT_SECRET from the auth service.

SECRET_KEY_BASE.description: Elixir secret key base for crypto operations (session signing, CSRF tokens). Auto-generated 64-char secret.

ERL_AFLAGS.description: Erlang distribution flags. inet_tcp ensures standard TCP clustering works on Railway.

ENABLE_TAILSCALE.description: Enable Tailscale-based clustering. Set to false for Railway (uses standard TCP).

DNS_NODES.description: DNS node names for Erlang clustering. Leave empty for single-node deployment.
